metadata.title: Palier
metadata.description: A free, open-source tool for practising the Public Service Commission's Second Language Evaluation.

footer.nonAffiliation: Palier is an independent, open-source study tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Public Service Commission of Canada. It contains no real test questions and its results are not official.

home.title: Practise for the Second Language Evaluation
home.tagline: Reading, written expression and oral practice for the Public Service Commission's SLE — no account, no cost, and it works offline.

about.title: What Palier is, and what it is not
about.independence: Palier is an independent study tool, built in the open. It is not the exam, and using it is not a substitute for the Public Service Commission's own preparation material.
about.noRealItems: It contains no real test questions. Every item is written or generated for practice, and no result it produces is official.

key.title: Your API key
key.intro: An OpenAI API key turns on the parts of Palier that use AI. Everything else works without one.
key.fieldHint: It starts with sk-. Paste the whole key.
key.tabOnly: Keep it for this tab only
key.tabOnlyHint: It is never written to this device, and closing or reloading the tab forgets it.

key.resultValid: This key works. OpenAI accepted it.
key.resultInvalidKey: OpenAI did not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one and paste it here.
key.resultOutOfCredit: OpenAI says this key has reached its usage limit or has no credit left. Check the billing and limits on your OpenAI account, then try again.
key.resultTimeout: OpenAI did not answer in time. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.

key.whereStored: Your key is stored in this browser, encrypted, and is sent only to OpenAI, when you use a feature that needs it.
key.whereNever: It is never synced to your other devices, never included in an export, and never sent to Palier’s server.
key.whereLimit: The encryption stops the key being read out of this browser’s storage. It cannot protect the key if this site itself were compromised, so give Palier a key of its own, with a monthly limit.
key.guideLink: How to create a key and set a spend limit
key.spendIntro: An estimate from the tokens OpenAI reports for each call, priced from Palier’s price list. OpenAI’s own usage page has the exact figure.
key.spendUnpriced: {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} this month used a model Palier has no price for, so this month’s figure is too low.
key.spendWhen: A week starts on Monday and a month on the 1st, in UTC, as on OpenAI’s usage page. A session is since you opened this tab.
key.spendDevice: Spending is counted on each device separately. OpenAI’s own limit covers all of them, and it is the real protection.
key.capIntro: Set yourself an amount for the month. Palier warns you at 80 percent and again when you reach it, before a feature spends. It never stops you: the limit on your OpenAI account does that.
key.capSet: Your cap is {cap} a month. This month is at {share} percent of it.
key.capNotNumber: That is not an amount. Type a number of dollars, such as 5 or 12.50.
key.capNotPositive: A cap must be more than zero.
key.capFailed: The cap could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.
key.capNear: This month is past 80 percent of your cap.
key.capOver: This month has reached your cap. Features that use AI still work, so check the limit on your OpenAI account.
key.capLimits: Set a hard limit on OpenAI’s limits page
key.featuresIntro: One typical use of each, estimated before you spend. The real cost depends on how much you write and on OpenAI’s prices.
key.featuresCaption: Estimated cost of one typical use
key.featureUse_writing-feedback: Feedback on one piece of your writing, with a model answer.
key.featureUse_item-generation: A new set of practice items, written and checked for you.
key.featureUse_oral-practice: One minute of a spoken practice session: the examiner's questions, voiced, and your answers transcribed.
key.featureUse_oral-assessment: One report on a spoken session: a level and evidence for each criterion, three things to work on, five useful words and your answers corrected.
key.offerHeading: An OpenAI key, if you want one
key.offerUnlocks: A key turns on the parts that use AI: feedback on your writing, fresh practice items written for you, and spoken practice with an examiner.
key.offerCosts: You pay OpenAI directly for what you use, and you can set a monthly limit on your OpenAI account.
key.offerStays: The key stays in this browser and is sent only to OpenAI. Everything else in Palier works without one.
key.guideIntro: Five steps, on OpenAI’s site. Palier sees none of it.
key.guideStep1: Sign in to your OpenAI account, or create one, at platform.openai.com.
key.guideStep2: On the billing page, add a payment method or credit: a key only works on an account that can pay.
key.guideStep3: On the API keys page, choose “Create new secret key”. Name it Palier, so you know what it is for, then copy it: OpenAI shows it only once.
key.guideStep4: On the limits page, set a monthly budget. That limit, not Palier, is what bounds what you can spend.
key.guideStep5: Come back here and paste the key into the field on Your API key.

oral.title: Spoken practice
oral.intro: Rehearse the oral interview in practice mode. The examiner asks a question, in writing and aloud; you answer; the next question follows from what you said.
oral.practiceMode: Each answer you record is sent to OpenAI to be written down, on your key. The recording of your answers stays on this device, and nothing here is synced or exported.
oral.purpose_warmup: Introductions, your role and your department. Low pressure, and a good first session.
oral.purpose_work: Describe your job, a project, a problem you solved. The bread and butter of the real test.
oral.purpose_opinion: The C-level discriminator: policy trade-offs, hypotheticals, what you would have done differently.
oral.purpose_situation: A scenario to handle: brief a colleague, decline a request, explain a delay to a client.
oral.purpose_full: Every part of the interview in turn, under exam conditions.
oral.noneAvailable: No spoken sessions are available in this version of the bank.

oralReport.title: Report on a spoken session
oralReport.notFound: This device holds no spoken session by that link. Sessions and their reports are kept on the device they were made on.
oralReport.costNote: Measured on this device from what OpenAI reported for each call, at Palier’s prices. OpenAI’s own usage page is the bill.
oralReport.stillRunning: This session has not ended, so it cannot be assessed yet.
oralReport.nothingToAssess: You gave no answer in this session, so there is nothing to assess.
oralReport.offer: Get a report on this session: a level for each criterion with evidence from your answers, the three things that would raise it most, five useful words and your answers corrected.
oralReport.offerUnpriced: You pay OpenAI directly for what you use.
oralReport.preflightEstimate: This report should cost about {amount}, paid to OpenAI.
oralReport.preflightUnpriced: There is no estimate for this report.
oralReport.preflightNear: This report would bring this month’s spending close to the limit you set in Palier. It is a reminder, not a block.
oralReport.preflightOver: This report would take this month’s spending past the limit you set in Palier. It is a reminder, not a block.
oralReport.sendsTo: Your transcript goes to OpenAI only, with your key, to be assessed. The report is kept on this device only, and never synced or exported.
oralReport.transcriptKept: Your transcript is kept on this device, and you can ask again.
oralReport.failNothing: You gave no answer in this session, so there is nothing to assess.
oralReport.fail_invalid-key: OpenAI did not accept your key. Check it on the key page, then try again.
oralReport.fail_out-of-credit: OpenAI says your key has reached its usage limit or has no credit left. Check your OpenAI account, then try again.
oralReport.fail_timeout: OpenAI did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
oralReport.fail_unreachable: OpenAI could not be reached. You may be offline.
oralReport.fail_unexpected: OpenAI’s answer was not in a form Palier could use, even on a second try. Try again.
oralReport.fail_no-key: There is no longer a key on this device. Add one to get a report.
oralReport.fail_failed: OpenAI returned an error. Try again later.
oralReport.noKeyTitle: A report needs an OpenAI key
oralReport.noKeyWhat: With a key, your answers are assessed against the Public Service Commission’s level descriptors: a level and evidence for each criterion, three things to work on, five useful words and your answers corrected.
oralReport.noKeyCost: About {amount} a report, paid to OpenAI directly.
oralReport.noKeyCostUnpriced: You pay OpenAI directly for what you use.
oralReport.noKeyStill: Your transcript, your fluency figures and your recording are here without one.
oralReport.pronunciationWhy: A transcript cannot show how you sound, so pronunciation is not assessed.
oralReport.fixesTitle: Three things to work on, most costly first
oralReport.fixesPlan: Your next practice sessions draw more items on these.
oralReport.wordsTitle: Five useful words you did not use
oralReport.transcriptHow: Each marked passage is a button: select it to see the correction.
oralReport.errorsNone: No errors were marked in your answers.
oralReport.fluencyNote: {count, plural, one {Measured over your one spoken answer.} other {Measured over your # spoken answers.}} The transcription may leave out some hesitations.
oralReport.fluencyTyped: You typed your answers, so there is no speech to measure.
oralReport.recordingLocal: Kept on this device only. It holds your answers and nothing else.
oralReport.recordingNone: There is no recording of this session on this device.
oralReport.recordingDeleteFailed: The recording could not be deleted. Try again.
